授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The course provides the basics of applied statistics. First, students learn how to compute measures of central tendency and dispersion for ungrouped and grouped data. Then, they study basic concepts of probability (random variables, probability distributions, mean, standard deviation, sampling distributions). Finally, basic methods of inferential statistics about estimating parameters, hypothesis tests, and regression are studied. Some commands for calculating measures using Python are also introduced.

"This course is a DX subject for developing DNA (Digital Native in Agriculture) human resources. You can acquire the following digital mind and skills (DMS).

2. You can acquire the knowledge and skills to solve a phenomenon using statistics.
3. You can learn about using Python programing language."
